info.title: Infoware Domino REST API design
info.description: CRUD for Domino design elements via Domino REST API. Create/update accepts raw DXL (text/xml) with a typed root element. Bulk GET/PUT /designdxl transfers all supported elements as CRUD-identical DXL. PUT /designdxl creates the NSF if missing (only bulk import); per-type CRUD requires an existing database. This API never deletes databases.

tags.name: design-element
tags.description: Database design element CRUD. Create/update accepts raw DXL (text/xml) with a typed root element

tags.name: design-handler
tags.description: Starter DXL defaults (GET /defaults, GET /defaults/{type}?kind= for script libraries) and bulk export/import (GET/PUT /designdxl). PUT creates the NSF if missing (bulk-only).

/defaults.summary: Starter design DXL from keepdesign.nsf or embedded JAR defaults
/defaults.description: Starter DXL per type. Script libraries and agents emit one entry per kind.

get.description: Returns { defaultNsf, elements: [{ type, name, dxl, source, kind? }] }. Script libraries appear once per kind.

/defaults/{type}.summary: Starter DXL for one design type

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Kind when type=scriptlibrary (lotusscript|javascript|ssjs|java), type=agent (lotusscript|formula|simpleaction|java), or type=javasource (class|interface|enum). Ignored for other types.

get.summary: Get starter design DXL for a type
get.description: Returns starter DXL. For scriptlibrary/agent, pass kind= to select the variant.

/designdxl.summary: Bulk export or import all supported design elements as CRUD-identical DXL
/designdxl.description: GET exports every supported design element. PUT imports an elements array (same DXL as per-type CRUD). Missing NSF is created on PUT only. PUT remaps connection via KeepConfig.nsf internally.

parameters.name: nsfPath
parameters.description: Target Domino database filepath (created on PUT if missing)

get.description: Returns { nsfPath, elements: [{ type, name?, dxl }] } for all supported design types.

put.description: Import elements with REPLACE_ELSE_CREATE, sign after each import, then compile LotusScript (fixes Notes 'use list module' errors). Creates the NSF when missing.

unid.description: Optional note UNID (for delete or precise replace)

delete.description: When true, delete the named/UNID design note instead of importing (dxl may be omitted)
